# The Mechanic · FinWise

> Module 3 · Retention & Engagement. The engagement mechanic that builds the habit loop, with rationale and a wireframe.

## The mechanic

**Mechanic:** Streak Counter

- **Trigger:** A notification
- **Action:** User has to confirm the transactions and their categories to get insights on spend
- **Reward:** They get spend insights every week
- **Investment:** They have connected the data and have adjusted spend patterns by setting budgets which will be hard to setup in a new tool

_____

## Rationale

A user about to churn would stay because they can now effectively see where they're spending more and adjust their spend to maximize business value which takes time to set up in a new tool if they switch
